page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance within the ecs.c6 instance family, managed via the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an x86_64 architecture powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. The instance provides 52 dedicated vCPUs paired with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation ratio of 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance configuration includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operational disk reads and writes. Networking capabilities feature a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The architecture is designed without dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs, focusing compute resource density entirely on CPU capabilities. The ratio of vCPUs to RAM prioritizes processor throughput over high-capacity memory footprint.

The compute-heavy balance of 52 vCPUs and 96.0 GB RAM delivers strong processor density relative to memory capacity, optimizing costs for workloads that demand substantial multi-threaded processing without extensive in-memory memory demands. Suitable deployment targets include CPU-intensive batch processing, high-throughput web service layers, compilation pipelines, continuous integration systems, and compute-focused distributed algorithms.
